German far-right AfD wins regional election, sparking concern

The far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party has achieved a record victory in a regional election, leading to both protests and celebrations. This win has caused concern among mainstream political parties in Germany. The AfD has previously expressed a positive view of Russia under Vladimir Putin, with some reports highlighting this connection. The election outcome has prompted widespread discussion about the future of German politics and the rise of far-right movements.
